Tavily now has three access rails, and the CLI is the default

PR #3204 · feat/tavily-cli-rail · click a rail to toggle it and see what the agent resolves to

What changed

Two agents told the model that Tavily is reachable only when TAVILY_API_KEY is set. That was already false: the tvly CLI persists auth in ~/.tavily/config.json and needs no environment variable at all. The old wording made agents skip Tavily on machines where it was working fine.

Before and after

agentbeforeafter
web-research-analyst "When TAVILY_API_KEY is available in the environment, prefer Tavily extract over WebFetch…"

frontmatter: required_mcp_servers: [tavily]		 Ordered access check: (1) tvly CLI, (2) tavily MCP if configured, (3) TAVILY_API_KEY. Concrete invocations (tvly search "q" --json), a pointer to the user-level tavily-* skills, and a credit-budget note.

frontmatter: required_mcp_servers removed
market-intelligence "When TAVILY_API_KEY is available, use Tavily search with "topic": "finance"…" Same ordered check, with tvly search "query" --topic finance --json and tvly research spelled out.
Why required_mcp_servers: [tavily] had to go. It declared a hard dependency on an MCP server for a capability that has two other rails. On a machine with the CLI authenticated and no MCP configured, the requirement was simply wrong.

The build defect this PR originally shipped with

Worth recording, because it is a repeatable trap rather than a one-off slip.

files changed, as opened:
  plugins/ork/agents/market-intelligence.md
  plugins/ork/agents/web-research-analyst.md

  src/ files touched:      0
  plugins/ files touched:  2

CI said:
  ##[error] Build drift detected! Run 'npm run build' and commit the changes

plugins/ is generated from src/ by npm run build. Editing it directly works locally and then evaporates on the next build, so CI regenerates the tree, sees the hand-edits vanish, and reports drift. CLAUDE.md states the rule plainly: edit src/ and manifests/, never plugins/.

The fix, and how it was verified. The same three content changes were ported into src/agents/market-intelligence.md and src/agents/web-research-analyst.md, then npm run build was run. The check that matters: 0 plugins/ files modified by the build, meaning src/ now produces byte-identical output to what the PR had hand-written. Agent validation passes 15/15. The build also regenerated two generator-owned reference pages under docs/site/content/docs/reference/agents/, which ship with the change.

The general lesson

  • A hand-edit to a generated tree is not a change, it is a change that is about to be reverted.
  • The drift gate is the only thing that catches it, and it catches it as Build rather than as something obviously named, which is why the failure reads as scary infrastructure breakage instead of a one-line layering mistake.
  • CI Summary going red alongside it is just the aggregator following.
